summary: Implemented E-4 Core phantom terminal advertising cleanup in AlembicCore only. BootstrapTerminalToolset now exposes only baseline or live terminal-run, legacy terminal-shell/terminal-pty env requests collapse to terminal-run, policy hints no longer mention terminal_shell/terminal_pty, WorkflowReportWriter sanitizes retired terminal ids from stage toolsets and terminal summary/capability inference, and focused tests prove live Core toolsets/report outputs no longer project phantom terminal_shell/terminal_pty as available tools. Commit 90c2295c0fb1eafe0e0a6468f8fb820343a2c695 on main.
evidenceRefs: validation:npm run test -- test/BootstrapTerminalToolset.test.ts -> 1 file, 4 tests passed
validation:npm run test -> 143 files, 1407 tests passed
verification: BootstrapTerminalToolset no longer maps run/shell/pty modes to terminal_shell or terminal_pty; only live terminal is returned for analyze/evolution stages.
Legacy ALEMBIC_TERMINAL_TOOLSET=terminal-shell or terminal-pty is normalized to terminal-run, keeping the real terminal capability while avoiding phantom advertising.
WorkflowReportWriter removes retired terminal ids from stage allowedToolIds and terminal summary/capability inference, so old diagnostics cannot report terminal-shell/terminal-pty as available tools.
No AlembicPlugin vendor, AlembicAgent, Alembic, E-1, E-2, E-3, or E-5 files were changed.
risks: npm run check still fails at the pre-existing lint:naming baseline for src/project-context-capabilities.ts, src/recipe-context-capabilities.ts, and src/test-fixtures.ts after all prior gates pass.
Alembic Guard MCP returned CODEX_MCP_ERROR/internal-error with response schema validation failures; no code guard finding was produced.
Vendor/plugin propagation is intentionally out of this Core-only task and remains for a later consumer package after Core acceptance.
